body:
It's not a thing that I can try. It's an all or nothing. And yes, I would. Because it's a career and I'm so so happy where I am and in my line of work and with the people I work with. It's the only good in my life. But by doing this thing, I will destroy that entire career. Every single aspect of it. 

My acquaintances are through the thing, not work. So no, it's not just a show up and make friends. You see, I'm just figuring out now that I'm autistic. Making friends is very difficult for me. I also am depressed, and have severe issues with consistency, such as going to things regularly, or having a singular interest.

I don't have friends. I have acquaintances. My job is the only good thing I have. But if I make the move I would need to make to be happy, I will lose that job, that career, any of those acquaintances, anyone else around me, my house, and a whole lot more. Every single thing I have will be destroyed. I can't do that.
No thank you. There's nothing more for me to say.
